nodes.description: Private address storing the contract deployer, assigned in the constructor.
Public token name string 'Turtle Dex Token'.
Public token symbol string 'TUR'.
Public constant token decimals set to 8.
Public constant 10 ** decimals used to scale the supply.
Public constant total supply of 5000 * decimalFactor tokens.
Mapping of address to token balance, the core ledger of the token.
Internal nested mapping storing ERC20 allowances owner => spender => amount.
Constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and records the deployer.
View function returning the balance of a given owner from the balances mapping.
View function returning the remaining allowance for a spender from the allowed mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient, guarded by a hard-coded block.timestamp check.
Transfers tokens on behalf of another address using an allowance, also guarded by a block.timestamp check.
Sets the allowance of a spender directly to the supplied value.
Increases the caller's allowance for a spender by an added value.
Decreases the caller's allowance for a spender, resetting to zero if the subtracted value exceeds the current allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner in constructor, transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against the constant 1545102693 in transfer and transferFrom.
require(block.timestamp >= 1545102693) inside transfer, making execution time-dependent.
require(block.timestamp >= 1545102693) inside transferFrom, making execution time-dependent.
Owner address parameter of balanceOf used to index the balances mapping.
Owner address parameter of allowance used to index the allowed mapping.
Spender address parameter of allowance used to index the allowed mapping.
Recipient address parameter of transfer receiving the transferred tokens.
Amount parameter of transfer deducted from the sender and added to the recipient.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance is debited.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom whose balance is credited.
Amount parameter of transferFrom checked against balance and allowance.
Spender address parameter of approve receiving the new allowance.
Allowance amount parameter of approve stored directly in the allowed mapping.
Spender address parameter of increaseApproval whose allowance is increased.
Amount parameter of increaseApproval added to the current allowance.
Spender address parameter of decreaseApproval whose allowance is decreased.
Amount parameter of decreaseApproval subtracted from the current allowance.
Local variable caching the current allowance before the decrease branch logic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to set the initial balance and the deployer address.
msg.sender supplies the source balance for transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and decreased in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key when writing the allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the owner key when increasing the allowance in increaseApproval.
msg.sender is the owner key when decreasing the allowance in decreaseApproval.
block.timestamp feeds the hard-coded timestamp gate inside transfer.
block.timestamp feeds the hard-coded timestamp gate inside transferFrom.
The transfer function executes the timestamp-gated require that can revert based on block.timestamp.
The transferFrom function executes the timestamp-gated require that can revert based on block.timestamp.
The constructor writes the deployer address state variable.
The constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance.
The constructor writes the full supply into balances[msg.sender].
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom debits the source balance and credits the destination balance.
transferFrom reads and decreases the allowed mapping entry for the spender.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval reads and updates the allowed mapping entry.
decreaseApproval reads and updates the allowed mapping entry.
The current allowance value is loaded from the allowed mapping into local variable oldValue.
The local oldValue is consumed by decreaseApproval to compute the new allowance.
The _owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The _owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The _to parameter is the credit key for the balances mapping in transfer.
The _value parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
The _from parameter is the debit key for the balances mapping in transferFrom.
The _to parameter is the credit key for the balances mapping in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is validated and moved between balances and allowances in transferFrom.
The _spender parameter keys the allowance written in approve.
The _value parameter is stored directly as the allowance in approve.
The _spender parameter keys the allowance updated in increaseApproval.
The _addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance in increaseApproval.
The _spender parameter keys the allowance updated in decreaseApproval.
The _subtractedValue parameter drives the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.

Parameter only keys the allowance write in approve.
Parameter only supplies the stored allowance value in approve.
Parameter only keys the allowance update in increaseApproval.
